backend/main.mo: Motoko actor handling user profiles, access control, data validation, and separate admin vs personal record storage with blob support.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing affected files, components, and test IDs for restoring Version 8 behavior.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH-themed color variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level app component switching between records and admin views based on identity and admin status.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout with header, footer, and optional header action for navigation.
frontend/src/components/PersonalRecords/: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout and clearing identity-scoped query caches.
Gate component that blocks access until the user signs in via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminGate.ts: Admin access gate that checks identity and admin status, showing loading, denial, or admin-only content.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminPanel.t: Admin dashboard for listing, creating, editing, and deleting records with tabbed navigation and mutation-driven refetching.
frontend/src/features/admin/personalReco: React Query hooks fetching all personal records for admins and a specific user's personal record.
frontend/src/features/admin/PersonalReco: Displays all users with personal records for admins and shows selected user details.
frontend/src/features/admin/queries.ts: React Query hook that retrieves all admin-managed records if the caller is an admin.
frontend/src/features/admin/useIsAdmin.t: Hook checking if the current authenticated principal is an admin using identity-scoped caching.
frontend/src/features/personalRecords/mu: Mutation hooks for creating, updating, and deleting personal records with image upload handling and cache updates.
frontend/src/features/personalRecords/qu: Fetches the current user's personal record with identity-scoped query management.
frontend/src/features/records/emptyState: Provides simple UI components for empty record lists and when no record is selected.
Defines React Query mutations for creating, updating, and deleting records with image upload handling and cache updates.
frontend/src/features/records/queries.ts: Placeholder module noting that record access is now admin‑only with public queries removed.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordDeta: UI component rendering full record details with optional edit/delete actions or read-only mode.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordForm: Form component for creating or editing a record with validation, image handling, and submit callbacks.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordImag: Image upload field that handles file selection, preview generation, clearing, and displaying existing images.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordsLis: Displays a list of records with avatars, selection highlighting, loading skeletons, and empty-state messaging.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordsPag: Main personal record page managing create, edit, view, and delete flows using mutations and form components.
frontend/src/features/records/types.ts: Defines record form data types and helpers for converting between frontend form data and backend Data structures.
frontend/src/features/records/validators: Validates record form fields including required fields, numeric ranges, formatting, and image size limits.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when changed.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, handling login, stored identity loading, and status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a large set of CSS variables for light and dark themes, applying global background and text colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider before rendering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from query strings or hash routing, using sessionStorage for persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, radius, fonts, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the current project state, tracking a request to restore the app’s behavior to Draft Version 8.
